findings.text: During shelter in place in the U.S. in 2020, eCommerce penetration among adults aged 18–64 was 42.3% for apparel, shoes, and accessories, 40.5% for grocery, and 36.1% for household products.

findings.text: For U.S. adults aged 18–24, expected post-shelter time-spend change versus 2019 was gaming 21%, audio 12%, video 11%, browsing 3%, and social media -5%.
